entries.name: IOUserBluetoothSerialDriver
entries.note: Serial over Bluetooth (RFCOMM) comes from the Linux rfcomm kernel module. bluetooth.rs drives the radio through the kernel management socket and does not open RFCOMM serial ports for apps. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: The rfcomm kernel module provides the Bluetooth serial ports. bluetooth.rs is tested; it does not open RFCOMM ports for apps, so the app-facing side stays out of scope.
